For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Piyush Kumar Pandey, Advocate
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Anant Kumar 1, App
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Chandra Shekhar Jha
 Oral Order
2 03-11-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.

2. The accused/petitioner is named in the FIR and apprehending his arrest in connection with Ara Nawada P.S. Case No.938 of 2019 registered under Sections 323, 498-A, 494, 497, 354, 376 of the Indian Penal Code as as well as Sections 3 and 4 Dowry Prohibition Act.

3. The present FIR is based upon Complaint Case No.1434 of 2019 filed before learned C.J.M.,
Bhojpur at Ara on 24.08.2019 through which the complainant raised allegation of cruelty and dowry demand against her husband Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.75552 of 2025(2) dt.03-11-2025 and in-laws, where allegation of rape also raised against father of this petitioner, who is none but the father-in-law of the complainant.

4. It is submitted by learned counsel appearing for the petitioner that the main allegation as raised through present complaint appears cruelty due to non-fulfilment of dowry and just to aggravate the allegation, the father-in-law was alleged to commit rape upon complainant.

The petitioner is the Santosh Kumar Rai @ Santosh Rai vs The State Of Bihar on 3 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/105618104/
1 husband and claimed clean antecedent.

sentences.text: 5. Learned APP opposed the prayer of bail.
6. In view of aforesaid factual submissions and by taking note of fact as petitioner is the husband,

, the petitioner, above-named, in the event of his arrest or surrender in the court below within a period of four weeks from today, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Ara at Bhojpur in connection with Ara Nawada P.S. Case No.938 of 2019, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.75552 of 2025(2) dt.03-11-2025 Criminal Procedure (in short 'CrPC')/under Section 482(2) of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (in short 'BNSS').
